rule: caught = parses, baseline check count, and the named test fails

supersededEvidence.name: legacy P93 mutation entries with caught/checks only
supersededEvidence.reason: The older file recorded historical 17-check and 19-check summaries without exact find/replace text, exit code, failed count or target test. This run replaces them with auditable file-scoped measurements.

results.why: The T1 journey must fail when the stub no longer fails the first selected gateway-deployment run.
results.namedTest: T1 operator journey runs selected steps, shows failed rerun and records exact installer scopes

results.why: The stub progress events must keep the P92 resumeCommand field on every event.
results.namedTest: T2 stub progress lines match the producer progress field contract

results.why: The TAP wrapper must reject skipped node:test subtests.
results.namedTest: TAP parser self-test rejects skipped subtests

results.why: The T4 detector must catch a child exit listener removed from the immediate post-spawn position.
results.namedTest: T4 child exit waits are registered immediately after spawn

results.why: A step-scoped preflight fingerprint must not cover every run scope.
results.find: return sha256Hex(canonicalize({ schemaVersion: 1, engine, answers: answers || {}, steps: scope }));
results.replace: return sha256Hex(canonicalize({ schemaVersion: 1, engine, answers: answers || {}, steps: 'full' }));
results.namedTest: P1 fingerprints canonicalize answer keys and cover step scopes

results.why: Integer coercion must not parse fractional or exponent text with parseInt.
results.namedTest: F4 integer coercion accepts exponent form and rejects fractional, text and out-of-range values

results.why: Run-starting controls must remain disabled while a run is active.
results.namedTest: U1 fix run-starting buttons are disabled while a run is active

results.why: Server modules must not carry non-delegating UI model function copies.
results.namedTest: the form uses fixed script routes and no string-built DOM insertion sinks
